newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- First railway project in Bosnia, funded by Saudi Arabia, has been completed at a cost of 7.5 million riyals.
- Jeddah municipality seizes a large quantity of expired canned food from markets.
- Preparations ready at Mena to receive nearly two million Moslem pilgrims.
- Saudi Cable Company posts a five million riyal profit in the first quarter of 1997.
